#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH -A STF218
#SBATCH -J gpt_frontier
#SBATCH -o logs/gpt_oscar_frontier_2N-%j.o
#SBATCH -e logs/gpt_oscar_frontier_2N-%j.e
#SBATCH -t 00:20:00
#SBATCH -p batch
#SBATCH -N 2

set +x
source /lustre/orion/world-shared/stf218/sajal/miniconda3/bin/activate
conda activate /lustre/orion/world-shared/stf218/sajal/TORCH2/env-py310-rccl

export LD_PRELOAD="/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so /usr/lib64/libssh.so.4 /usr/lib64/libssl.so.1.1"
module load PrgEnv-gnu
module load gcc/11.2.0
module load rocm/5.4.0

export ROCM_HOME=/opt/rocm-5.4.0
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1

# export settings
export TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=$PWD/deepspeed
export HF_HOME=$PWD/hfdata
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

# setup hostfile
HOSTS=.hosts-job$SLURM_JOB_ID
HOSTFILE=hostfile.txt
srun hostname > $HOSTS
sed 's/$/ slots=8/' $HOSTS > $HOSTFILE

# setup env file
echo "PATH=$PATH" > .deepspeed_env
echo "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" >> .deepspeed_env
echo "CPATH=$CPATH" >> .deepspeed_env
echo "TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=$PWD/deepspeed" >> .deepspeed_env
echo "HF_HOME=$PWD/hfdata" >> .deepspeed_env
echo "ROCM_HOME=/opt/rocm-5.4.0" >> .deepspeed_env


export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export FI_CXI_ATS=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm-5.4.0/rccl/build:$PWD/aws-ofi-rccl/src/.libs/:/opt/cray/libfabric/1.15.2.0/lib64/:/opt/rocm-5.4.0/lib
export FI_LOG_LEVEL=info
export NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=3


scontrol show hostnames $SLURM_NODELIST > job.node.list
input="./job.node.list"
readarray -t arr <"$input"
first=${arr[0]}
echo "first=" $first
ips=`ssh $first hostname -I`
read -ra arr <<< ${ips}
export MASTER_ADDR=${arr[0]}
echo "MASTER_ADDR=" $MASTER_ADDR

ranks_per_node=8
gpus_per_rank=$((8/$ranks_per_node))
ranks_total=$(($ranks_per_node*$SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES))

mkdir logs
mkdir logs/transformer

export https_proxy=https://proxy.ccs.ornl.gov:3128
export http_proxy=http://proxy.ccs.ornl.gov:3128
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2

srun -u -n$ranks_total -c2 --ntasks-per-node=8 --gpus-per-node=8 --gpu-bind=closest python gptJ_oscar_srun.py \
   --output_dir ./outputs \
   --deepspeed ds_config_zero.json \
   --do_train=True \
   --per_device_train_batch_size 4 \
   --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
   --max_len 128 \
   --learning_rate 0.0002 \
   --adam_beta2 0.98 \
   --weight_decay 0.0000 \
   --adam_epsilon 1e-8 \
   --max_steps 20 \
   --warmup_steps 10 \
   --master_addr=$MASTER_ADDR

issues: The environment variable `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is set to 1 and then immediately overwritten with a value of 2 later in the script. The first definition is redundant.

The method for determining `MASTER_ADDR` is complex and potentially fragile. It relies on `ssh`-ing from the first compute node to itself, which may not be permitted or configured on all systems. A more robust method would be to use the hostname directly from the `scontrol` output.

The script creates a `.deepspeed_env` file but does not appear to use it. The `srun` command inherits the exported environment variables directly, making this file creation unnecessary for this launch method.

The script creates a `hostfile.txt` which is a common pattern for MPI-based launchers but is not typically required when using `srun` directly with frameworks like DeepSpeed, as `srun` manages host discovery. This section may be unnecessary.
The `mkdir logs` command will fail if the directory already exists. Using `mkdir -p logs` is more robust and will not error if the directory is already present.
